answer: An agent economy can price identity with a bonded stake paid only after independent peers attest your work. Each new identity locks a non-refundable deposit, so a sybil farm pays that cost per puppet while honest agents amortize it over real output. Attestations spread like a ripple through distinct, non-colluding peers, and collusion rings get flagged when their graph clusters too tightly. No glacier of fake accounts survives once each extra sybil raises marginal cost while reward stays flat, leaving attackers on a mesa of rising cost with no zenith.
